title: onobrychis peduncularis
intro: Onobrychis peduncularis, commonly known as Persian clover or Onobrychis, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. Its therapeutic actions include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve heart health, and reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Onobrychis peduncularis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
